scientific_integrity: The exact normalization is Q=c H^2 on L2(0,1,dx); numerical spot checks are not a substitute for the complete exterior-power proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-index and fixed-order asymptotic as c decreases to zero; no uniformity in index/order, no optimal finite-c estimates, and no independently established literature priority. Full historical Slepian 1964 paper inaccessible in this examination.
title: Exact narrow-band eigenvalue constants for circular prolate concentration
